definition: OMIM #618089 denotes Intellectual Developmental Disorder with Dysmorphic Facies and Behavioral Abnormalities (IDDFBA), a neurodevelopmental disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the FBXO11 gene. It is characterized by variable degrees of intellectual disability, global developmental delay, speech and language impairment, behavioral issues, dysmorphic facial features, and variable manifestations such as hypotonia, seizures, ocular abnormalities, and skeletal findings.

source.title: FBXO11 variants are associated with intellectual disability and variable clinical manifestation in Chinese affected individuals
source.quote: F-box protein 11 (FBXO11) is a member of F-Box protein family, which has recently been proved to be associated with intellectual developmental disorder with dysmorphic facies and behavioral abnormalities (IDDFBA, OMIM: 618089).
